source.stem:
Problem:

A convex polygon is called elegant if it can be decomposed into equilateral triangles, squares, or both, all having sides of the same length. Some elegant polygons are shown below, together with a decomposition and the number of sides of each.
![](figures/mathnet_02qx__1.jpg)
4 sides
![](figures/mathnet_02qx__2.jpg)
5 sides
![](figures/mathnet_02qx__3.jpg)
6 sides
![](figures/mathnet_02qx__4.jpg)
7 sides
a) Draw an elegant polygon with 8 sides and show a decomposition of it.
b) What are the possible measures of the interior angles of an elegant polygon?
c) Show that an elegant polygon cannot have more than 12 sides.
d) Draw an elegant polygon with 12 sides and show a decomposition of it.
